comparison.noGroups: This window has no drives in the warm or cold parking-gap groups.

comparison.help: A drive is a cold start when the car sat parked for 6+ hours first, and a warm start when the gap is 1 hour or less. Comparing distance-weighted consumption between the groups isolates the battery- and cabin-warm-up penalty; in-between gaps are excluded as ambiguous.
